Filter one audio file with FFmpeg

Source: R/02_filter_audio.R
pam_filter_one.Rd

Base R only, so it can be shipped to parallel workers without the package installed. Writes to <output>.part and renames on success, so an interrupted run never leaves a half-written file that looks finished.

Usage

pam_filter_one(item, filter, ffmpeg = "ffmpeg")

Arguments

item

List with input, output (paths) and bits (input bit depth; 16, 24 or 32 are preserved, anything else becomes 16).

filter

Filter string from pam_highpass_filter_string().

ffmpeg

Executable name or path.

Value

A list: ok (logical) and message (last FFmpeg error lines, or "").
